answer: Presence becomes much harder to fake when three nearby devices must submit matching ambient clips in the same five seconds, each signed by its own owner, forming a quorum for a shared room. One phone could play a recording, but three independent recorders hearing the same kettle whistle and the same passing footsteps cannot be staged by one operator without three real devices in three real places. A tone clear as crystal still needs that simultaneity, a prism of separate microphones splits one room into three agreeing views, and the summit of the test is agreement, not volume.
